title: The UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin WordPress plugin before 2.26.16.26, UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration…
description: UpdraftPlus: WP Backup & Migration Plugin versions before 2.26.16.26 and 1.26.16 contain a vulnerability where serialized string lengths are not properly maintained during database search and replace operations. This allows users with Subscriber role to inject data that can be interpreted as attacker-controlled PHP objects after an administrator performs certain operations like URL-lengthening search and replace or migration restore. No direct exploit gadget chain is known in the plugin itself; impact depends on other installed code.
